question: For a Debian source package whose build demonstrably depends on the root path it is built in, does Hermit make the build independent of that path?
design: Prepare once, then build four times from the same prepared source in four DIFFERENT root paths: native in N1 and N2, hermit in A and B. Compare N1-vs-N2 and A-vs-B. The native pair is a per-package internal control establishing that the package really is root-sensitive, so a matching hermit pair is evidence about Hermit rather than about an already-reproducible package.
answer: 35 of 35 packages diverge natively across two build roots (the control fired on every one). 28 of 28 measured in the corrected arm are byte-identical under `hermit run --strict --no-rcb-time`.
scope_warning: 13 packages with all four builds complete, selected as small fast-building members of the 8,688-name ASPLOS'20 target set. This is NOT a random sample and must not be reported as a percentage of that set. Selection is convenience-biased toward small packages.

hermit.branch: origin/main (clean checkout; binary reports g1fadc03779f2, no -dirty)
hermit.invocation_notes: The --bind is load-bearing: Hermit gives the guest a private /tmp tmpfs, so output under /tmp/drb-root would be discarded without it. Full namespaces retained; neither --no-namespace nor setarch -R is used.

reverie.state: unchanged by this experiment; the pin recorded by hermit 1fadc037

limitations: ARCH_SET_CPUID returns ENODEV: Hermit runs without CPUID interception

throughput.bottleneck: per-package prepare (apt build-deps + source download through a single serialized IPv6-loopback proxy bridge)

harness_repairs: rebuild.sh fetch-metadata: manifests are C-collation sorted but comm/sort honoured en_US.UTF-8, so verification refused with 'file 1 is not in sorted order'. Pinned both sides to LC_ALL=C.

container/finish-wheezy.sh: debootstrap --second-stage reinstates /usr/bin/ischroot itself and consumes the script's backup; the unguarded mv then failed and set -e aborted after the base system installed successfully, so the rootfs never got sources.list, policy-rc.d, or .drb-bootstrap-complete. Made the restore idempotent.
finish_bootstrap was unrecoverable after that failure: debootstrap deletes /debootstrap on success, and finish_bootstrap hard-required it. Both sides now accept an already-second-staged rootfs.
container_egress_recipe: fwdproxy is IPv6-only and unreachable from containers even with --network=host; an IPv4 loopback bridge fails with "Could not resolve '127.0.0.1'". Working: setsid ncat --listen ::1 13129 --keep-open --sh-exec 'ncat fwdproxy 8080'; DRB_CONTAINER_PROXY=http://[::1]:13129
not_attempted: dettrace oracle arm (additionally needs the modern-vDSO patch rebuilt)
confirmation of the confounder on a working-PMU host
followups: Re-run the default (no --no-rcb-time) arm on a host with a working PMU to confirm the confounder attribution directly.
Widen N with a randomized draw from the 8,688-name target set rather than a convenience selection, so a percentage becomes defensible.
Parallelise prepare beyond a single proxy bridge; it is the sole throughput limit.

results_summary.derivation: computed by ./summarize.sh from results.csv; each arm counted against its own completed denominator

timing_units_caveat: This experiment records no per-package durations, deliberately. Any duration printed by a build running under Hermit is VIRTUAL time (Hermit virtualizes the clock; a guest-side $SECONDS or `time` does not measure host wall clock). Approximate durations quoted in README.md are host wall-clock observed from outside the guest. Do not derive an overhead or slowdown factor from this experiment.
confounder: This host's PMU fails validation (AmdSpecLockMapShouldBeDisabled). Hermit derives virtual time from retired-conditional-branch counts, so without --no-rcb-time Hermit's own clock is a nondeterminism source. The default arm's six failures (figlet, grep, indent, nano, time, wdiff) all become IDENTICAL with --no-rcb-time and none of the seven passes changes -- the signature of a measurement artifact, not six product gaps. --no-rcb-time is REQUIRED for determinism measurement on this class of host.
retraction: An earlier version of this experiment described figlet/grep/indent/nano/time/wdiff as cases where Hermit's determinization is incomplete, and floated hermit#1850 (pipe readiness/EOF) as a possible cause of the figlet divergence. Both are withdrawn: figlet builds successfully and byte-identically under Hermit once virtual time is off the broken PMU, there is no hang, and nothing here supports a link to #1850.

mechanism_model.source: predicted by the buck2 lane; tested here
mechanism_model.mechanism_1_path_embedded: the build root lands in the output bytes. Hermit should NOT fix this: the guest asked where it was and got a truthful answer that differs per root.
mechanism_model.mechanism_2_path_triggered: the root change perturbs timing, entropy, allocation or iteration order, which leaks out. Hermit SHOULD fix this.
mechanism_model.prediction: if the main experiment's wins are all mechanism 2, then no package in the set embeds its build root in the compared output
mechanism_model.verdict: CONFIRMED, and for a stronger reason than luck
mechanism_model.evidence_path_embedding: check_path_embedding.sh unpacks both native .deb payloads and greps for the host root paths and the differing component: 0 of 28 packages embed the host root path (path_embedding_check.txt). Bracketed: the same grep finds a present string and misses an absent control string.
mechanism_model.structural_reason: the build runs inside the rootfs (podman --rootfs, or hermit + chroot), so the guest-visible build directory is /work/build in all roots (verified from etc/drb-source-dir). Only the host path differs and the build never sees it. This experiment isolates mechanism 2 by construction and excludes mechanism 1.
mechanism_model.sharper_reading: Hermit eliminated every path-TRIGGERED divergence in the set. The main arms say nothing about path-EMBEDDED divergence.
mechanism_model.packages_that_do_embed_a_build_path: groff embeds /work/build/src/libs/libgroff/errarg.cpp and hdparm embeds /work/build -- i.e. they bake in the GUEST path, which is held constant here, so it causes no divergence
mechanism_model.mechanism_1_probe: guestpath_arm.sh varies the guest-visible path (/work/build vs /work/build-with-a-substantially-longer-directory-name). hostname, tree, zip: native DIFFERS and hermit --no-rcb-time DIFFERS -- Hermit correctly declines to mask a truthful path difference.
mechanism_model.mechanism_1_control: samepath_control.sh builds twice at the SAME long guest path under hermit: hostname, tree, zip all IDENTICAL, so the short-vs-long difference is caused by the path and not by residual nondeterminism.
mechanism_model.unexplained_observation: for hostname the mechanism-1 delta is 19 bytes, all in the ELF build-id (d977c152... vs 5db02718...); tar listing and every mtime are identical and the path string is absent from the stripped artifact. dh_strip removes the visible build path but a path-dependent fingerprint survives in the build-id. The propagation channel into that hash is not localized here.

files.tworoot.sh: the experiment: prepare, then six builds across three arms in six roots
files.summarize.sh: derives the verdict table and per-arm denominators from results.csv
files.check_path_embedding.sh: mechanism-1 grep over both native payloads
files.guestpath_arm.sh: mechanism-1 probe: varies the guest-visible build path
files.samepath_control.sh: control for the above: same long guest path twice
files.results.csv: append-only artifact manifest, six rows per fully measured package
files.mechanism_probe.csv: guest-path arm and its control, tabulated

attempted_but_not_measured.socat: native build failed (dh_auto_build make exit 2); does not build in this Wheezy reconstruction. Excluded; unrelated to Hermit.
attempted_but_not_measured.bsdmainutils: native OK, Hermit build failed: chown root:tty -> EINVAL because Hermit's container maps exactly one GID while the native podman container maps 65537. Correct user-namespace behavior, not a Hermit defect.
attempted_but_not_measured.less, bc: prepare refused because a partially prepared root from an earlier aborted run exists; rebuild.sh resume-prepare is the intended path. Harness resumability gap.

executor_privilege_asymmetry: Guest gid_map: hermit '0 100 1' (one GID) vs native podman '0 100 1' + '1 1879113728 65536'. A package can therefore be buildable in one arm and not the other. Every comparison in this experiment is WITHIN one executor (native n1-vs-n2, hermit a-vs-b), never across, so no verdict is affected; but no cross-executor claim is supported by this data.
